collocations.phrase: a bend in the road / river
collocations.example: The village lies just beyond a bend in the river. 村子就在河流拐弯处的那一边。
He begged for forgiveness on bended knee. 他跪着请求原谅。

wordForms.noun: bend 弯道，弯曲处；bent 天分，爱好（have a bent for sth）
wordForms.verb: bend 弯曲（不规则变化：bend – bent – bent）
wordForms.adjective: bent 弯的，弯曲的；bendy 易弯曲的，多弯道的（口语）
wordForms.other: 不规则动词 bend–bent–bent，切勿写成 bended；bended 只保留在固定短语 on bended knee(s) 中。bent 一词三用：过去式/过去分词、形容词「弯的」、名词「天分」（注意「天分」义属于 bent，不是 bend 的名词义）。另注意 bent on doing sth = 决心做某事（He is bent on becoming a doctor.），与「弯曲」义无关。

classPractice.question: The nurse ______ (bend) down and checked the child's temperature again.
classPractice.note: and 连接的并列谓语 checked 为过去时，故此处也用过去式；bend 是不规则动词，过去式为 bent，不能写 bended。

classPractice.question: 学校为这名生病的学生破了一次例。The school ______ ______ ______ for this sick student.
classPractice.note: bend the rules for sb = 为某人通融/破例；句中时间已过，用过去式 bent。

translation: adj. 看不见的，无形的；（人、贡献等）被忽视的，不受重视的；（经济）无形的（指服务贸易）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: impossible to see, because it is too small, transparent, or hidden from view

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人或付出）被无视的，得不到关注的
uncommonMeanings.example: Quiet students often feel invisible in a big class.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （经济学）无形的，非实物的（invisible trade / exports 指服务贸易）
uncommonMeanings.example: Tourism and shipping count as invisible exports.

posExamples.sentence: Most microorganisms are invisible to the naked eye.
Respiratory droplets are nearly invisible, yet they can carry viruses far.
Years of hard work behind the vaccine remained invisible to the public.

collocations.phrase: be invisible to the naked eye
collocations.example: A single bacterium is invisible to the naked eye. 单个细菌是肉眼看不见的。
After treatment the scar is virtually invisible. 治疗后那道疤几乎看不见了。
Social distancing forms an invisible barrier against droplets. 保持社交距离形成一道挡住飞沫的无形屏障。
Doctors call the new virus an invisible enemy. 医生把这种新病毒称作看不见的敌人。
The spy wrote the address in invisible ink. 那名间谍用隐形墨水写下地址。
Fog made the mountain completely invisible. 大雾使那座山完全看不见了。
Teenagers who are never listened to may feel invisible. 从不被倾听的青少年可能会觉得自己被忽视。

collocations.translation: （经济）无形出口，无形贸易（指服务贸易）
collocations.example: Banking and insurance are valuable invisible exports. 银行业和保险业是价值可观的无形出口。

wordForms.noun: invisibility 隐形，看不见；invisibles（经济）无形贸易项目
wordForms.verb: —（无对应动词；相关动词为 see / visualize 想象、使可视化）
wordForms.adjective: invisible 看不见的 ↔ visible 看得见的
wordForms.adverb: invisibly 无形地，看不见地 ↔ visibly 明显地，看得出地
wordForms.other: 构词：否定前缀 in- + 词根 vis-（看，源自拉丁 videre）+ 后缀 -ible（能被……的）→「不能被看见的」。同根词族：vision 视力/视野、visual 视觉的、revise 复习（再看一遍）、supervise 监督（从上面看）、evidence 证据。拼写规律：in- 在 b/m/p 前变 im-（impossible、immoral），在 l 前变 il-（illegal），在 r 前变 ir-（irregular），在 v 前仍写 in-（invisible）。副词 invisibly 修饰动词，形容词 invisible 作表语或定语，不要混用。

classPractice.question: Bacteria are so tiny that they are ______ (visible) to the naked eye.
classPractice.note: so ... that 结果状语从句表示「小到肉眼看不见」，需否定意义的形容词；visible 加否定前缀 in- 变 invisible。

classPractice.question: Under a microscope, germs that are ______ to the naked eye suddenly become clearly ______. (visible / invisible)
classPractice.note: 第一空说肉眼看不见，用 invisible；第二空由 suddenly become clearly 提示「显微镜下变得清晰可见」，用 visible。两空构成对比。

translation: vt. 组成，构成（常用 be composed of）；创作（乐曲、诗歌）；撰写（信件、讲稿）；使（自己）镇定；调解（分歧）；（印刷）排字
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to be the parts that together form something; to write music or words; to make yourself calm again

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使（自己）平静下来，恢复镇定（compose oneself）
uncommonMeanings.example: She took a deep breath to compose herself before speaking.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 调解，平息（争端、分歧）
uncommonMeanings.example: The two sides finally composed their differences.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （印刷业）排字，排版
uncommonMeanings.example: In the old workshop every page was composed by hand.

posExamples.sentence: The human body is composed of trillions of cells and microorganisms.
Beethoven composed his Ninth Symphony after he had lost his hearing.
He paused to compose himself before facing the whole class.

collocations.example: Blood is composed of cells and plasma. 血液由细胞和血浆组成。

collocations.phrase: A and B compose sth（主动式）
collocations.example: Fifty students compose this class. 五十名学生构成了这个班。

collocations.phrase: compose music / a song / a symphony
collocations.example: He composed a song to cheer up the patients. 他创作了一首歌为病人打气。

collocations.phrase: compose a poem / a letter / a speech
collocations.example: She composed a letter of thanks to the nurses. 她写了一封感谢信给护士们。
Give him a minute to compose himself. 给他一分钟让自己镇定下来。
The doctor stayed composed during the emergency. 急救时医生始终保持镇定。
He sat quietly to compose his thoughts. 他静静坐着整理思绪。
The committee helped compose their differences. 委员会帮助双方消除了分歧。

wordForms.noun: composition 构成，成分；作文；作曲作品｜composer 作曲家｜composure 镇定，沉着
wordForms.verb: compose 组成，创作，使镇定
wordForms.adjective: composed 镇定的，沉着的；composite 合成的，复合的
wordForms.other: 构词：com-（共同）+ pos-（放置）→「放到一起」＝组成／创作。同根家族：expose 暴露（向外放）、impose 强加（放上去）、propose 提议（向前放）、suppose 假设、oppose 反对、deposit 存放。用法辨析：be composed of ＝ be made up of ＝ consist of「由……组成」，但 consist of 无被动形式；若主语是「部分」、宾语是「整体」，则用主动的 compose：Fifty students compose this class. 词形易错：composition（成分/作文）≠ composure（镇定）。

classPractice.question: The human gut is ______ (compose) of trillions of bacteria, most of which are harmless.
classPractice.note: be composed of「由……组成」为固定被动搭配，主语 gut 是被构成的整体，故用过去分词 composed。

classPractice.question: 深呼吸几次之后，她镇定下来，继续做报告。After a few deep breaths, she ______ ______ and went on with her talk.
classPractice.note: compose oneself ＝ 使自己镇定；反身代词须与主语 she 一致，用 herself；与 went on 并列，用过去式 composed。

translation: vt. 使接触，使暴露于（expose sb/sth to sth）；揭露，揭发（真相、丑闻）；使显露，使无遮蔽；（摄影）使（胶片）曝光
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to leave something uncovered or unprotected so that it meets an outside influence; to make known something bad or hidden

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 揭露，揭发（罪行、骗局、真相）
uncommonMeanings.example: The journalist exposed a fake vaccine factory.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （摄影）使胶片曝光
uncommonMeanings.example: Don't open the camera or you will expose the film.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使（潜藏之物）显露出来，使失去遮蔽
uncommonMeanings.example: The falling tide exposed the rocks along the shore.

posExamples.sentence: Health workers are exposed to respiratory droplets every day.
A vaccine exposes the body to a harmless part of the virus.
The report exposed serious problems in the local health system.

collocations.phrase: expose sb / sth to sth（= be exposed to sth）
collocations.translation: 使接触，使暴露于；接触到
collocations.example: Nurses are exposed to germs far more often than office workers. 护士接触病菌的机会远多于办公室职员。
Don't expose yourself to unnecessary infection risk. 不要让自己面临不必要的感染风险。

collocations.phrase: expose the truth / a scandal / a lie
collocations.example: The team exposed the truth behind the outbreak. 团队揭露了这场疫情背后的真相。
He was exposed as a fake doctor. 他被揭穿是个假医生。

collocations.translation: 对……的接触量、暴露程度（名词形式）
collocations.example: Long exposure to loud noise damages hearing. 长时间接触噪音会损害听力。
The storm washed away the soil and left the roots exposed. 暴雨冲走泥土，使树根裸露在外。

collocations.translation: 无遮蔽的、易受风吹的山坡（位置）
collocations.example: They camped on an exposed hillside and froze all night. 他们在毫无遮蔽的山坡上露营，冻了一夜。

wordForms.noun: exposure 接触，暴露；揭露；（摄影）曝光
wordForms.verb: expose 使暴露，揭露
wordForms.adjective: exposed 无遮蔽的，易受伤害的
wordForms.other: 构词：ex-（向外）+ pos-（放）→「放到外面」＝暴露。与本单元 compose（com- 共同放＝组成）同根，可连起来记：expose / compose / impose / propose / oppose / dispose。词形易错：名词是 exposure，不是 exposition（exposition 意为「展览会；阐述」）。句型固定：expose A to B，被动为 A be exposed to B，to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。重音在第二音节 /ɪkˈspəʊz/。

classPractice.question: Health workers are ______ (expose) to respiratory droplets far more often than office staff.
classPractice.note: be exposed to sth「接触到，暴露于」；主语 workers 是承受者，用被动语态，故填过去分词 exposed。

classPractice.question: A vaccine works by ______ the body to a harmless part of a virus. (expose / compose)
classPractice.note: 「让身体接触……」用 expose sth to sth；compose 意为「组成、创作」，语义不通。介词 by 后须用动名词，故为 exposing。

translation: n. 核心，要点，最重要的部分；果核；地核；（反应堆）堆芯；（健身）核心肌群 adj. 核心的，最主要的 vt. 去掉（水果的）核
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: the most important or central part of something; the hard central part of a fruit containing the seeds

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 果核（苹果、梨等的中心硬部）
uncommonMeanings.example: She threw the apple core into the rubbish bin.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 给（水果）去核
uncommonMeanings.example: Peel and core the pears before you cook them.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 地核；核反应堆的堆芯
uncommonMeanings.example: The Earth's core is made mostly of iron.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （健身）核心肌群（腰腹背部肌肉）
uncommonMeanings.example: Planks are a simple way to strengthen your core.

posExamples.sentence: Hand washing lies at the core of preventing infection.
Sleep, diet and exercise are core factors in psychological well-being.
Wash and core the apples before adding the sugar.

collocations.example: Trust is at the core of doctor–patient communication. 信任是医患沟通的核心。

collocations.phrase: the core of the problem / issue
collocations.example: Poor sleep is the core of her anxiety. 睡眠不足是她焦虑的症结。
Honesty is one of our school's core values. 诚实是我们学校的核心价值观之一。
English remains a core subject in senior high school. 英语仍是高中的核心科目。

collocations.phrase: a core member / the core team
collocations.example: She is a core member of the vaccine research group. 她是疫苗研究小组的骨干成员。
The diagnosis shook him to the core. 那个诊断结果让他深受震动。
Planks build core strength and protect the lower back. 平板支撑能增强核心力量，保护下背部。
Temperatures at the Earth's core are unbelievably high. 地核处的温度高得难以置信。

wordForms.noun: core 核心；果核
wordForms.verb: core 去核（cored, coring）
wordForms.adjective: core 核心的，主要的（只作定语）
wordForms.other: core 名词、形容词、动词三者同形。作形容词时只能作定语（core value / core subject），不可作表语，不能说 This is very core。复合词：hard-core 铁杆的、core competence 核心竞争力、core curriculum 核心课程。发音提示：core /kɔː(r)/ 与 corps（军团，单数 /kɔː(r)/，p、s 不发音）同音；形近词 corn 谷物、cord 绳索、cork 软木塞，注意区分。

classPractice.question: 良好的睡眠是心理健康的核心。Good sleep lies ______ ______ ______ ______ mental well-being.
classPractice.note: lie at the core of sth ＝「是……的核心」；四空依次填 at / the / core / of，of 后接名词短语 mental well-being。

classPractice.question: Wash, peel and ______ (core) the apples before you boil them.
classPractice.note: 考 core 的熟词僻义：作及物动词表示「给水果去核」。与 Wash、peel 构成并列祈使句，用动词原形。

translation: vt. 入侵，侵略（国家、领土）；（病菌、疾病）侵入，侵袭（人体）；侵犯（隐私、空间、权利）；大批涌入，挤满；（念头、情绪）涌上，侵扰
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to enter a place or a body by force in order to take control of it or to cause harm

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （病菌、病毒）侵入人体或细胞
uncommonMeanings.example: Bacteria invade the body through tiny cuts in the skin.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 侵犯（隐私、个人空间、权利）
uncommonMeanings.example: The newspaper invaded the patient's privacy.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人群）大批涌入，挤满某处
uncommonMeanings.example: Tourists invade this small town every summer.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （情绪、念头）涌上心头，侵扰
uncommonMeanings.example: A feeling of panic invaded her mind before the speech.

posExamples.sentence: Viruses invade healthy cells and use them to reproduce.
Roman armies invaded Britain nearly two thousand years ago.
Anxious thoughts invaded her mind the night before the exam.

collocations.translation: 入侵一个国家（一片领土）
collocations.example: The army invaded the neighbouring country in 1939. 军队于1939年入侵了邻国。
Harmful bacteria invade the body through the nose and mouth. 有害细菌通过口鼻侵入人体。
Reporters invaded the patient's privacy. 记者侵犯了这位病人的隐私。
Standing too close invades other people's personal space. 站得太近会侵犯别人的私人空间。
The lake was invaded by an alien water plant. 那片湖被一种外来水生植物侵占。
Worries invaded his mind at midnight. 半夜里担忧涌上他的心头。

collocations.translation: 入侵的军队；入侵的病菌
collocations.example: White blood cells attack invading germs at once. 白细胞立刻攻击入侵的病菌。

wordForms.noun: invasion 入侵，侵略；侵犯｜invader 入侵者，侵略者
wordForms.verb: invade 入侵，侵入（规则变化：invade – invaded – invaded）
wordForms.adjective: invasive 侵入性的，扩散性的（invasive species 入侵物种；invasive surgery 侵入性手术）｜invading 入侵的（现在分词作定语）
wordForms.other: 构词：in-（进入）+ vad-（走，拉丁 vadere）→「走进去」＝入侵。同根词族：evade 逃避（走出去）、pervade 弥漫（走遍各处）、evasion 逃避。名词变形规律：invade → invasion（去掉 e，加 -sion），没有 invadement 这个词。语法要点：invade 是及物动词，直接跟宾语，不可说 invade into a country。

classPractice.question: The skin is the body's first line of defence against bacterial ______ (invade).
classPractice.note: against 是介词，后接名词；形容词 bacterial 也提示需名词。invade 的名词形式是 invasion，不能写成 invadement。

classPractice.question: 那些记者侵犯了这位病人的隐私。The reporters ______ the patient's ______.
classPractice.note: invade sb's privacy ＝ 侵犯某人隐私；invade 为及物动词，直接接宾语，不加 into。事情已发生，用过去式 invaded。

translation: v. 消化（食物）；（酶、细菌）分解；领会，融会贯通（信息、消息） n. 文摘，摘要，汇编
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to break food down in the body so that it can be used; to take in and fully understand new information

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 文摘，摘要，汇编（读音重音前移 /ˈdaɪdʒest/）
uncommonMeanings.example: The website sends a weekly digest of health news.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 领会，消化（消息、知识），想明白
uncommonMeanings.example: I need a day to digest what the doctor told me.

posExamples.sentence: Gut bacteria help us digest food that our own body cannot break down.
Give students time to digest new information before the test.
He reads a short digest of medical research every Monday.

collocations.example: It takes hours to digest a heavy meal. 消化一顿大餐要好几个小时。

collocations.translation: 助消化，改善消化（用名词 digestion）
collocations.example: A short walk after dinner aids digestion. 饭后散步有助消化。

collocations.translation: 易（难）消化的；易（难）理解的
collocations.example: Fried food is hard to digest late at night. 深夜吃油炸食品很难消化。
She needed a whole day to digest the report. 她花了整整一天来消化这份报告。
Microorganisms live throughout the digestive system. 微生物遍布整个消化系统。
Digestive enzymes break proteins into smaller pieces. 消化酶把蛋白质分解成更小的片段。
He checks a daily news digest on his phone. 他在手机上看每日新闻摘要。
The test result took some digesting. 那个检查结果得好好消化一阵。

wordForms.noun: digestion 消化（作用）｜digest 文摘｜indigestion 消化不良
wordForms.verb: digest 消化，领会（规则变化：digest – digested – digested）
wordForms.adjective: digestive 消化的（digestive system）｜digestible 易消化的、易懂的 ↔ indigestible 难消化的
wordForms.other: 重音辨义：动词 digest /daɪˈdʒest/ 重音在后，名词「文摘」digest /ˈdaɪdʒest/ 重音在前，符合英语「名前动后」规律（record、present、increase、export 同理）。构词：di-（＝dis，分开）+ gest（携带，同 gesture 手势、suggest 提议）→「分开搬运」＝消化。抽象名词 digestion 指消化过程，不可与 digest（文摘）混用。

classPractice.question: Good ______ (digest) depends partly on the bacteria living in our gut.
classPractice.note: 空处作句子主语并被形容词 Good 修饰，须用名词；digest 对应的抽象名词是 digestion（消化作用），而 digest 作名词只表示「文摘」。

classPractice.question: 这个检查结果我需要点时间消化一下。I need some time to ______ the test result.
classPractice.note: digest 除「消化食物」外，还可指「领会、消化（消息、信息）」；不定式符号 to 后用动词原形 digest。

translation: n. 压力，紧张（心理）；强调，重点；重音，重读；（物理）应力 vt. 强调，着重指出；重读（音节）；使焦虑，使紧张
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: worry and tension caused by difficulties in life; to give special importance to something when you speak or write

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 重音；重读（某个音节）
uncommonMeanings.example: In 'invade' the stress falls on the second syllable.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （物理）应力，受力
uncommonMeanings.example: The metal bar bends when the stress becomes too great.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使焦虑，使紧张（口语常用 stress sb out）
uncommonMeanings.example: The endless mock exams really stressed the students out.

posExamples.sentence: Long-term stress weakens the immune system and invites infection.
Doctors stress that vaccines protect the whole community, not just individuals.
In the word 'invisible', the stress falls on the second syllable.

collocations.translation: 处于压力之下；开始承受压力
collocations.example: Hospital staff came under great stress during the outbreak. 疫情期间医院员工承受了巨大压力。
Regular exercise helps relieve stress. 规律运动有助于缓解压力。
Learning to cope with stress is a life skill. 学会应对压力是一项生活技能。
The doctor stressed the importance of hand washing. 医生强调了洗手的重要性。
She stressed that masks block respiratory droplets. 她强调口罩能挡住呼吸道飞沫。
The new course puts stress on mental well-being. 这门新课程强调心理健康。
Headaches can be a stress-related illness. 头痛可能是一种与压力有关的疾病。

collocations.translation: 焦虑不堪，压力爆表（口语）
collocations.example: He was completely stressed out before the finals. 期末考前他焦虑不堪。

wordForms.noun: stress 压力；强调；重音
wordForms.verb: stress 强调，重读，使紧张（规则变化：stress – stressed – stressed）
wordForms.adjective: stressful 压力大的，令人紧张的（修饰事物）｜stressed 感到有压力的（修饰人）
wordForms.other: 关键辨析：stressed 形容人「感到有压力」，stressful 形容事「令人有压力」——I feel stressed because this job is stressful. 名动同形，无需变形。stress 与 emphasis 用法平行：lay stress on sth ＝ lay emphasis on sth；对应动词 stress ＝ emphasize，二者都可直接跟宾语或 that 从句，不加介词（不说 stress on that ...）。派生词：stress-free 无压力的、de-stress 减压。

classPractice.question: Living with constant pressure can be extremely ______ (stress) for teenagers.
classPractice.note: 主语 Living with constant pressure 是「事」，表语应用 stressful（令人有压力的）；stressed 只用来形容人感到有压力。

classPractice.question: 医生反复强调按时接种疫苗的重要性。The doctor repeatedly ______ ______ ______ ______ getting vaccinated on time.
classPractice.note: stress the importance of (doing) sth ＝ 强调（做）某事的重要性；四空依次填 stressed / the / importance / of，of 是介词，后接动名词 getting。

translation: n. 互动，交往，交流；相互作用，相互影响
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: the process by which two or more people, things or systems act on and influence each other

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （医学）（药物之间的）相互作用，配伍反应
uncommonMeanings.example: Some drug interactions can be dangerous for older patients.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （物理）基本相互作用，作用力
uncommonMeanings.example: Gravity is one of the four fundamental interactions in nature.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （统计）交互效应，交互作用
uncommonMeanings.example: The study found a clear interaction between age and treatment.

posExamples.sentence: Close interaction between gut microbes and the brain affects our mood.
Social interaction protects older people from cognitive decline.
Ten days of isolation left him with almost no interaction with others.

collocations.example: Regular social interaction supports psychological well-being. 经常的人际互动有助于心理健康。

collocations.translation: A 与 B 之间的相互作用
collocations.example: Researchers study the interaction between gut bacteria and the immune system. 研究者研究肠道细菌与免疫系统之间的相互作用。
Her interaction with young patients is warm and patient. 她与小病人的互动亲切而有耐心。
Masks reduce the spread of droplets during face-to-face interaction. 口罩减少了面对面交流时的飞沫传播。
Teachers use games to make classroom interaction more natural. 老师用游戏让课堂互动更自然。
The patient in isolation had no interaction with others for ten days. 隔离中的病人十天没有与他人往来。
The new seating plan encourages interaction between students. 新的座位安排鼓励学生之间的互动。

wordForms.noun: interaction 互动，相互作用；interactivity 交互性
wordForms.verb: interact 互动，相互作用（interact with sb/sth）
wordForms.adjective: interactive 互动的，交互式的
wordForms.adverb: interactively 交互地，以互动方式
wordForms.other: 构词法：前缀 inter- 表“在……之间、相互”，同族词有 international、interview、interrupt、intersect。可数性提示：指一次次具体的往来时可数（daily interactions with classmates）；指抽象的“相互作用过程”时常不可数（the interaction of light and matter）。

classPractice.question: Scientists are studying the ______ (interact) between gut microbes and the human brain.
classPractice.note: the 与 between 之间缺名词，作 are studying 的宾语；动词 interact 加名词后缀 -ion 构成 interaction，指“相互作用（的过程）”。

classPractice.question: 疫苗与人体免疫系统之间的相互作用非常复杂。(interaction)
classPractice.answer: The interaction between vaccines and the human immune system is very complex.
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 the interaction between A and B；主语中心词是单数抽象名词 interaction，谓语用 is，不要被 vaccines 的复数干扰。

translation: vt. 怀疑，猜想（某事可能属实）；怀疑（某人有罪）；不信任 n. 嫌疑人，可疑分子；（问题的）可疑起因 adj. 可疑的，靠不住的
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to believe that something, usually something bad, is probably true; to believe that someone may be guilty; (n.) a person or thing thought to be responsible

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 可疑的，不可靠的（多修饰数据、说法、食物、包裹等）
uncommonMeanings.example: The figures in that health report look rather suspect.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （造成问题的）可疑起因，“元凶”
uncommonMeanings.example: Sugary drinks are the prime suspect in the rise of obesity.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 不信任，对（动机、诚意）有疑虑
uncommonMeanings.example: I suspect his motives for offering us free tests.

posExamples.sentence: Doctors suspected that the infection had spread through respiratory droplets.
The main suspect in the outbreak was contaminated drinking water.
His account of the missing samples sounds highly suspect.

collocations.example: I suspect that the virus spread through droplets. 我猜想病毒是通过飞沫传播的。

collocations.phrase: suspect sb of (doing) sth（被动 be suspected of doing sth）
collocations.translation: 怀疑某人（做了）某事；被怀疑做了某事
collocations.example: They suspected him of hiding his symptoms, and later he was suspected of carrying the virus. 他们怀疑他隐瞒了症状，后来他又被怀疑携带病毒。
The hospital reported three suspected cases of flu. 医院报告了三例流感疑似病例。

collocations.translation: 首要嫌疑人；主要可疑起因
collocations.example: Poor hand hygiene is the prime suspect here. 洗手不彻底是这里的首要可疑原因。

collocations.translation: 强烈怀疑，很有理由认为
collocations.example: Researchers strongly suspect a link between gut microbes and mood. 研究者强烈怀疑肠道微生物与情绪之间存在联系。
As I suspected, the second test came back positive. 正如我所料，第二次检测结果呈阳性。

collocations.translation: 毫无察觉，一点也没起疑心
collocations.example: The family suspected nothing until the boy's fever rose sharply. 家人一直毫无察觉，直到男孩发起高烧。

wordForms.noun: suspect 嫌疑人；suspicion 怀疑，嫌疑
wordForms.verb: suspect 怀疑，猜想（规则变化：suspect-suspected-suspected）
wordForms.adjective: suspect 可疑的、靠不住的（可作表语 look suspect，也可作定语 suspect data）；suspicious 可疑的；起疑心的（be suspicious of）
wordForms.adverb: suspiciously 可疑地；满腹狐疑地
wordForms.other: 重音辨义：动词 /səˈspekt/ 重音在后，名词和形容词 /ˈsʌspekt/ 重音在前，同类还有 record、present、object。句意辨析：suspect that... ≈ think that...（认为后面的内容是真的）；doubt 表示“不信”，肯定句中后面多接 whether/if（I doubt whether he will come），两词方向相反。

classPractice.question: The traveller was suspected ______ having been infected by respiratory droplets.
classPractice.note: be suspected of doing sth“被怀疑做过某事”；of 是介词，后用动名词的完成被动式 having been infected，表示“被感染”先于“被怀疑”。

classPractice.question: 用 suspect / doubt 的适当形式填空：① I ______ that the new cases all came from one wedding, though we cannot prove it yet. ② I ______ whether he has fully recovered; he is still coughing badly.
classPractice.note: suspect that = 认为后面的内容多半是真的（≈think），①有猜测但无证据，用 suspect；doubt = 认为不大可能，肯定句中常接 whether/if，②不信他已痊愈，用 doubt。

translation: n. 着迷，入迷，痴迷；魅力，吸引力；令人着迷的事物
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: a very strong interest in someone or something, or the quality that makes something very interesting

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 魅力，诱人之处（指事物本身的吸引特质，不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: The deep sea has a special fascination for biologists.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 令人着迷的事物、乐趣所在（可数，常用复数）
uncommonMeanings.example: One of the fascinations of lab work is never knowing the result.

posExamples.sentence: Microorganisms hold a strange fascination for the young researcher.
Her fascination with vaccines began during a serious flu outbreak.

collocations.example: He has a fascination with tiny living things. 他对微小的生物十分着迷。
The world under a microscope holds a fascination for children. 显微镜下的世界对孩子有巨大吸引力。
The fascination of the unknown drives science forward. 未知事物的魅力推动着科学前进。
She had a lifelong fascination with the human brain. 她一生痴迷于人脑研究。

collocations.translation: 无穷的乐趣，无尽的吸引力
collocations.example: Gut bacteria are a source of endless fascination. 肠道细菌是无穷乐趣的来源。
The students watched in fascination as the bacteria grew. 学生们着迷地看着细菌生长。

collocations.translation: 对……原理／原因的着迷（介词后接 wh- 从句）
collocations.example: Her fascination with how the immune system works led her to medicine. 她对免疫系统运作原理的着迷把她引向了医学。

wordForms.noun: fascination 着迷；魅力
wordForms.verb: fascinate 使着迷（sth fascinates sb）
wordForms.adjective: fascinating 迷人的（修饰事物）；fascinated 着迷的（修饰人，be fascinated by/with）
wordForms.adverb: fascinatingly 迷人地，引人入胜地
wordForms.other: 介词方向别搞反：人对物着迷用 a fascination with sth；物对人有吸引力用 hold a fascination for sb。-ing/-ed 形容词的人／物之分同 interesting-interested。词源为拉丁语 fascinare“施魔法”，故有“被迷住”的意味。

classPractice.question: The world under the microscope has a special ______ (fascinate) for young students.
classPractice.note: a special 后面必须跟名词，且 have a fascination for sb 表“对某人有吸引力”；fascinate 去掉词尾 e 加 -ion 变 fascination。

classPractice.question: 他对微生物的痴迷始于一堂生物课。His ______ ______ microorganisms began in a biology lesson.
classPractice.note: 人对某物着迷固定用介词 with；此处作句子主语的中心词，须用名词 fascination，不能用形容词 fascinated。

translation: n. 个人，个体；（某类）人 adj. 单独的，个别的；供一人用的；个人的；独特的，有个性的
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: (n.) a single person or living thing considered separately from a group; (adj.) belonging to or meant for one person or thing only

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （生物）个体，一个生物体
uncommonMeanings.example: Each individual in the group carries a different set of gut bacteria.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 独特的，有个人风格的
uncommonMeanings.example: The designer has a very individual style of her own.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式，含戏谑或不满）家伙，某类人
uncommonMeanings.example: A strange individual was hanging around the laboratory.

posExamples.sentence: Each individual carries a unique community of gut microorganisms.
Vaccines protect individual children and the whole community as well.
Her individual way of teaching keeps every student wide awake.

collocations.example: Individual differences in gut bacteria affect our weight. 肠道细菌的个体差异影响我们的体重。
Isolation rules must balance public safety and the rights of the individual. 隔离规定必须在公共安全与个人权利之间取得平衡。

collocations.translation: 因人而异的、个性化的做法
collocations.example: Doctors now take an individual approach to treatment. 医生如今采取个性化的治疗方案。
Small classes let teachers give individual attention to each learner. 小班教学让老师能对每个学生给予个别关注。

collocations.translation: 私人，个人（与机构、政府相对）
collocations.example: Part of the research was paid for by private individuals. 部分研究经费由私人出资。
As individuals, we react to the same vaccine differently. 作为个体，我们对同一种疫苗的反应各不相同。
The canteen now offers individual portions to reduce contact. 食堂现在提供单人份餐食以减少接触。

wordForms.noun: individual 个人，个体；individuality 个性，独特性；individualism 个人主义
wordForms.verb: individualise / individualize 使个性化，因人而异地对待
wordForms.adjective: individual 个别的，独特的；individualistic 个人主义的
wordForms.other: 名词 individual 可数，表“个人”时前面必须有 a/an、the 或用复数：every individual + 单数谓语。作定语时可与 each 连用加强“逐一”之意（each individual student）。the individual 与 the community/society 对举时，表“个人”这一整体概念。

classPractice.question: Because reactions to the vaccine differ, nurses check each patient ______ (individual).
classPractice.note: 空处修饰动词 check，须用副词 individually“逐个地、单独地”，与前面的 reactions ... differ 呼应。

classPractice.question: 疫苗既保护个人，也保护整个社区。(the individual)
classPractice.answer: Vaccines protect both the individual and the whole community.
classPractice.note: the individual 用单数表“个人”这一整体概念，与 the community 对举；both...and... 连接两个并列宾语。

translation: vt. 尝试，试图（做某事）；试着解答（题目） n. 尝试，努力；企图，图谋
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to try to do something, especially something difficult; (n.) an act of trying to do something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对某人生命的）加害企图，行刺（an attempt on sb's life）
uncommonMeanings.example: There was an attempt on the scientist's life after the discovery.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英式，考试用语）作答，试做（试题、考卷）
uncommonMeanings.example: Attempt all five questions within one hour.

posExamples.sentence: Scientists attempted to grow the bacteria in a new medium.
Her first attempt at making yogurt at home failed completely.
The town closed its schools in an attempt to stop infection.

collocations.example: Doctors attempted to trace everyone the patient had met. 医生试图追踪病人接触过的所有人。

collocations.phrase: make an attempt to do sth / at doing sth
collocations.example: They made an attempt at growing the microbe in the lab. 他们尝试在实验室里培养这种微生物。

collocations.phrase: in an attempt to do sth
collocations.example: In an attempt to cut droplet spread, students wore masks indoors. 为减少飞沫传播，学生在室内戴口罩。
After several failed attempts, the vaccine finally worked. 几次失败的尝试之后，疫苗终于奏效。
He passed the driving test at the first attempt. 他第一次尝试就通过了驾驶考试。
She refused to give up the attempt to isolate the bacteria. 她拒绝放弃分离这种细菌的尝试。
Police stopped an attempt on the mayor's life. 警方阻止了一起谋害市长的企图。

wordForms.noun: attempt 尝试，企图（本身即名词，无 attemption 一词）
wordForms.verb: attempt 试图，尝试（规则变化：attempt-attempted-attempted）
wordForms.adjective: attempted 未遂的（attempted murder 谋杀未遂）
wordForms.other: 句型：attempt to do sth 与 attempt doing sth 都合语法，前者远为常见；名词搭配用 make an attempt to do sth 或 an attempt at doing sth，注意 at 后接动名词。语体上 attempt 比 try 正式，且不能进入口语结构 try and do。

classPractice.question: In an attempt ______ (stop) the virus spreading, the town closed all its schools.
classPractice.note: in an attempt to do sth 是固定搭配，表目的；此处 attempt 是名词，后面只能接不定式 to stop，不能用 stopping。

classPractice.question: 经过几次失败的尝试之后，她终于分离出了那种细菌。After several ______ ______, she finally isolated the bacteria.
classPractice.note: attempt 作名词可数，several 后须用复数 attempts；failed attempt 是常见搭配，表“未成功的尝试”。

translation: vt. 系上，贴上，把……固定在；把（文件）作为附件发送；认为（有重要性、意义）；使依恋；使隶属，暂调至 vi.（罪责、后果等）归于，属于
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to fasten or join one thing to another; also, to consider that something has a particular importance or quality

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 认为（某事）有（重要性、价值、意义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Doctors attach great importance to washing hands properly.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）（过错、责任等）归于，落在……身上
uncommonMeanings.example: No blame attaches to the nurse who reported the case.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使依恋，使喜爱（多用于 be/become attached to sb）
uncommonMeanings.example: The children quickly became attached to the school nurse.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使隶属，把（人）暂调到（某单位）
uncommonMeanings.example: He was attached to a research team in Beijing for a year.

posExamples.sentence: The virus attaches itself to cells lining the throat.
Please attach your test result to the application form.
Health experts attach great importance to keeping a safe distance.

collocations.translation: 把 A 系／贴／固定在 B 上
collocations.example: Attach the label to the sample bottle. 把标签贴在样本瓶上。
The virus attaches itself to the cells inside the nose. 病毒附着在鼻腔内的细胞上。
Our school attaches great importance to public health. 我们学校非常重视公共卫生。
She is deeply attached to her grandmother. 她非常依恋祖母。

collocations.phrase: attach a file to an email
collocations.example: I've attached the lab report to this email. 我已把化验报告作为附件发给你。
The government attached strict conditions to the funding. 政府对这笔资助附加了严格条件。
The report attached no blame to the hospital staff. 报告没有把过错归到医院工作人员身上。

wordForms.noun: attachment 附件；依恋，眷恋；附属装置
wordForms.verb: attach 系上，附上（规则变化：attach-attached-attached）；反义 detach 拆下，使分离
wordForms.adjective: attached 附上的；依恋的（be attached to）；detachable 可拆卸的
wordForms.other: attach 后固定接介词 to（attach sth to sth），不说 attach sth on/with sth。前缀 de- 构成反义词 detach。名词 attachment 一词两用：电子邮件“附件”与心理学“依恋”（attachment theory 依恋理论）。

classPractice.question: Under the microscope you can see how the virus attaches ______ (it) to a healthy cell.
classPractice.note: attach itself to sth 表“（使自己）附着在……上”，主语 the virus 为第三人称单数中性，反身代词用 itself。

classPractice.question: 我们应当高度重视勤洗手和戴口罩。(attach)
classPractice.answer: We should attach great importance to washing our hands often and wearing masks.
classPractice.note: attach importance to 中的 to 是介词，后面必须接名词或动名词，不能写成 to wash。

translation: n. 巨大成功，重大成就；胜利；（胜利后的）喜悦，得意 vi. 获胜，成功；战胜，克服（over）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: a great success or victory, or the feeling of great satisfaction it brings; (v.) to win or succeed, especially after a hard struggle

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 得意洋洋，狂喜（不可数，多用于 in triumph）
uncommonMeanings.example: She held up the negative test result in triumph.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 杰作，典范（a triumph of sth，指某领域的了不起成果）
uncommonMeanings.example: The vaccine was a triumph of modern science.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （历史）（古罗马的）凯旋式，庆功游行
uncommonMeanings.example: The victorious general was given a triumph in Rome.

posExamples.sentence: The defeat of smallpox was a triumph for modern medicine.
Good sense finally triumphed over fear during the outbreak.
He smiled in triumph when the test came back negative.

collocations.example: The new vaccine is a triumph for the research team. 这种新疫苗是研究团队的重大成功。

collocations.phrase: a triumph of A over B
collocations.translation: A 战胜 B 的典范
collocations.example: Her recovery was a triumph of will over illness. 她的康复是意志战胜疾病的典范。
She triumphed over depression with her family's support. 在家人支持下她战胜了抑郁。
The medical team returned home in triumph. 医疗队凯旋而归。
Finishing the race after his illness was a personal triumph. 病后跑完全程是他个人的巨大成功。
The media hailed the discovery as a triumph. 媒体称这一发现为一大成就。
Beating the illness gave him a strong sense of triumph. 战胜疾病给了他强烈的成就感。

wordForms.noun: triumph 胜利，重大成就
wordForms.verb: triumph (over sth) 战胜，取得成功（规则变化：triumph-triumphed-triumphed）
wordForms.adjective: triumphant 得胜的，欢欣鼓舞的；triumphal 庆祝胜利的（triumphal arch 凯旋门）
wordForms.adverb: triumphantly 洋洋得意地，成功地
wordForms.other: triumphant 用于人或情绪（a triumphant smile），triumphal 只用于庆祝胜利的仪式或建筑，二者不可互换。词源为古罗马的“凯旋式 triumphus”。可数性：指一次具体胜利可数（a triumph for the team），指“得意心情”不可数（in triumph）。

classPractice.question: The children came out of the hospital ______ triumph, waving their negative test results.
classPractice.note: in triumph 是固定介词短语，意为“得意洋洋地、凯旋地”，在句中作方式状语修饰 came out。

classPractice.question: 在家人的支持下，她战胜了长期的焦虑。(triumph)
classPractice.answer: With her family's support, she triumphed over her long-term anxiety.
classPractice.note: triumph over sth 表“战胜、克服”，over 不能省略；win 的宾语只能是比赛、战争、奖项，不能直接接“困难、疾病”，此处不可用 win。

translation: vt. 重复，重说；重做；复述，转述；重播 vi. 重复发生；（食物）反胃 n. 重复；（电视节目的）重播
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to say or do something again, or to happen again; (n.) something that is said, done or broadcast again

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 转述，外传（他人的话，多用于否定句）
uncommonMeanings.example: Please don't repeat what I told you about her illness.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （电视、广播的）重播节目
uncommonMeanings.example: There is nothing on TV tonight but repeats.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 留级，重读（一学年、一门课）
uncommonMeanings.example: After months in hospital he had to repeat the year.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英式口语）（食物）反胃，吃后长时间留有味道
uncommonMeanings.example: Raw garlic always repeats on me.

posExamples.sentence: Could you repeat the name of that vaccine, please?
History repeats itself when people forget the last epidemic.
Careful hand washing prevents a repeat of last winter's outbreak.

collocations.translation: 重复自己说过的话；（历史等）重演
collocations.example: Sorry, I'm repeating myself — I said that a minute ago. 抱歉，我又重复了，一分钟前说过。
Repeat after me: wash your hands before eating. 跟我读：饭前要洗手。
We must avoid a repeat of last year's outbreak. 我们必须避免去年疫情的重演。
Scientists repeated the experiment ten times to be sure. 科学家把实验重复了十次以确认结果。
He missed too many lessons and had to repeat a year. 他缺课太多，只好留级。

collocations.translation: 续开的处方（不必再看医生）
collocations.example: The doctor gave her a repeat prescription for her inhaler. 医生给她开了吸入器的续方。
She played the same song on repeat all evening. 她整晚循环播放同一首歌。

wordForms.noun: repetition 重复（抽象行为）；repeat 重播节目；一次重复
wordForms.verb: repeat 重复（规则变化：repeat-repeated-repeated）
wordForms.adjective: repeated 反复的，一再的；repetitive 单调重复的；repetitious 啰嗦重复的（贬义）
wordForms.other: 名词形式是 repetition，没有 repeatment 这个词。动词为规则变化 repeat-repeated-repeated，不要受 eat、beat 影响误写成不规则形式。repeat 本身已含“再”，不能说 repeat again。搭配区分：repeat sth to sb（把话转述给某人）≠ repeat after sb（跟着某人读）。

classPractice.question: He was so nervous during the presentation that he kept ______ (repeat) himself.
classPractice.note: keep doing sth“不停地做某事”后接动名词；repeat oneself 意为“重复说过的话”，反身代词 himself 与主语 he 一致。

classPractice.question: 严格的隔离措施防止了去年疫情的重演。(a repeat of)
classPractice.answer: Strict isolation measures prevented a repeat of last year's outbreak.
classPractice.note: a repeat of sth 表“……的重演”，repeat 在此为可数名词，须加 a；prevent 后直接接名词短语作宾语，只有接动词时才用 prevent sb from doing。

translation: n. 路线，路径；（公交、航空等的）固定线路；途径，渠道 vt. 按特定路线发送（信件、电话、货物、数据等）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: a way taken from one place to another; also a means or channel by which something spreads or is sent

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕（达到某目的的）途径，办法
uncommonMeanings.example: Vaccination is the safest route to community protection. 接种疫苗是保护群体最安全的途径。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕把……按某条线路发送、转接或运送
uncommonMeanings.example: All emergency calls are routed to one central desk. 所有急救电话都转接到一个中心台。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕〈美〉（送报、送奶等的）固定投递线路；这类送货的活儿（a paper route）
uncommonMeanings.example: He earned pocket money doing a paper route before school. 上学前他靠送报的活儿挣些零花钱。

posExamples.sentence: Droplets are the main route of transmission for many respiratory viruses. 飞沫是许多呼吸道病毒的主要传播途径。
We took a longer route home to avoid the crowded market. 我们绕远路回家，以避开拥挤的市场。
Blood samples are routed through a special lab for testing. 血样被送往一个专门的实验室做检测。

collocations.example: Respiratory droplets are a common route of transmission. 呼吸道飞沫是常见的传播途径。
Regular hand-washing is a simple route to better health. 勤洗手是通往更好健康的简单途径。
The ambulance took the fastest route to hospital. 救护车走了最快的路线赶往医院。
She began to feel feverish en route to school. 她在上学途中开始发烧。

collocations.translation: 逃生路线，安全出口通道
collocations.example: Every lab must have a clearly marked escape route. 每个实验室都必须有标识清楚的逃生通道。
All the data is routed through a secure server. 所有数据都经由一台安全服务器传输。
Scientists mapped out the route the virus had taken. 科学家勾画出了病毒的传播路径。

wordForms.noun: route 路线；途径；routing 路线安排，线路选择
wordForms.verb: route（routed, routed；现在分词 routing，英式亦写作 routeing）按线路发送／运送
wordForms.adjective: —（无常用形容词形式；表"例行的、常规的"用同源词 routine）
wordForms.other: 英音 route /ruːt/ 与 root（根）读音完全相同，拼写勿混（美音 route 也可读 /raʊt/）。route 与 routine 同源于法语 route（道路）：走熟的路→常规。固定短语 en route /ˌɒn ˈruːt/ 保留法语发音，后接 to 或 for。

classPractice.question: All calls about the outbreak are ______ (route) to a special health hotline.
classPractice.note: 此处 route 用作动词，与主语 calls 构成被动结构 be routed to "被转接到"；全句为一般现在时。

classPractice.question: 飞沫是这种病毒的主要传播途径。Droplets are the main ______ ______ ______ for this virus.
classPractice.note: "传播途径"的固定表达是 route of transmission（也可倒过来说 transmission route）；后面接具体病毒时用 for 或 of 均可。

translation: vt. 遭遇，遇到（困难、危险、反对等）；（偶然）遇见，邂逅 n. （尤指意外的）相遇，邂逅；遭遇；（体育、军事上的）交锋
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to meet someone or experience something, especially something new, difficult or unexpected; a meeting of this kind

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕（双方的）交锋，对阵，较量
uncommonMeanings.example: The two teams meet again in tonight's encounter. 两队将在今晚的对阵中再度交手。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: close encounter 近距离接触（尤指与不明飞行物、外星生物）
uncommonMeanings.example: The film describes a close encounter with aliens. 这部电影讲述了一次与外星人的近距离接触。

posExamples.sentence: The body encounters the virus and learns to recognise it. 身体遇到这种病毒后就学会了识别它。
Researchers encountered several problems while testing the new vaccine. 研究人员在测试新疫苗时遇到了几个问题。
A chance encounter with a doctor changed her whole career. 与一位医生的偶遇改变了她的整个职业道路。

collocations.example: We encountered unexpected difficulties in the experiment. 我们在实验中遇到了意想不到的困难。
The mask rule encountered resistance from some residents. 这条口罩规定遭到了部分居民的抵制。
When the body encounters a virus for the first time, it produces antibodies. 身体初次接触某种病毒时会产生抗体。
A chance encounter in the lab led to their friendship. 实验室里的一次偶遇促成了他们的友谊。
Her first encounter with a microscope amazed her. 她第一次接触显微镜时惊叹不已。

collocations.phrase: an encounter between A and B
collocations.translation: 甲与乙之间的相遇／交锋
collocations.example: The encounter between the two teams ended in a draw. 两队的交锋以平局收场。

collocations.translation: 常见于……，在……中可以遇到（多用于书面说明文）
collocations.example: This bacterium is commonly encountered in soil. 这种细菌常见于土壤中。

wordForms.noun: encounter 相遇；遭遇；交锋
wordForms.verb: encounter（encountered, encountered）遭遇；偶遇
wordForms.other: 构词：源自古法语 encontrer（en- 来自拉丁 in-"在……之中" + contra"相对、对面"）→ 面对面碰上。用法关键：动词 encounter 是及物动词，直接跟宾语（encounter difficulties，不说 ×encounter with difficulties）；名词 encounter 后须接 with（an encounter with a stranger）。语体上比 meet、come across 更正式。

classPractice.question: The immune system can remember almost every virus it has ______ (encounter).
classPractice.note: virus 后是省略了关系代词 that/which 的定语从句，从句用现在完成时 has encountered，故填过去分词 encountered。

classPractice.question: 那节课是她第一次接触免疫学。That lesson was her first ______ ______ immunology.
classPractice.note: 名词 encounter 后必须接介词 with；若改用动词则直接说 She first encountered immunology in that lesson（不加 with）。

translation: v. （使）滚动，翻滚；卷起，卷成筒状；（车辆）行驶；（雷声、鼓声）隆隆作响；（船只）左右摇晃 n. 卷，卷状物；小圆面包；名册，花名册；滚动；（鼓的）连击声
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to move along by turning over and over, or to turn something into a tube or ball; a tube-shaped object, a small round loaf, or an official list of names

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕名册，花名册（call the roll 点名）
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher called the roll before the lesson. 老师上课前点了名。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 小圆面包，餐包
uncommonMeanings.example: He had a cheese roll and an apple for lunch. 他午餐吃了一个奶酪面包和一个苹果。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕（雷声）隆隆作响
uncommonMeanings.example: Thunder rolled across the valley all night. 雷声整夜在山谷里隆隆作响。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （船、飞机）左右摇晃
uncommonMeanings.example: The ship rolled heavily in the storm. 船在暴风雨中剧烈摇晃。

posExamples.sentence: He rolled up his sleeve and waited quietly for the injection. 他挽起袖子，安静地等着打针。
The ball rolled slowly across the floor and stopped. 球慢慢滚过地板，停了下来。
Bring a roll of kitchen paper to wipe the desks. 拿一卷厨房纸来擦桌子。

collocations.translation: 挽起袖子；（引申）撸起袖子加油干
collocations.example: Roll up your sleeve, please — it takes one second. 请把袖子挽起来，一秒钟就好。

collocations.translation: 推出，推行（疫苗、政策、产品）
collocations.example: Hospitals rolled out the new vaccine last winter. 医院去年冬天开始推行这种新疫苗。
The patient rolled over so the nurse could listen. 病人翻了个身，好让护士听诊。

collocations.translation: 翻白眼（表示不屑或无奈）
collocations.example: He rolled his eyes when I mentioned masks again. 我又提到口罩时他翻了个白眼。
We used two rolls of tape to seal the box. 我们用了两卷胶带把箱子封好。

collocations.phrase: call the roll / a roll call
collocations.example: A roll call is taken in every class each morning. 每天早上每个班都要点名。

collocations.translation: 使某事启动，先把局面打开
collocations.example: One simple question got the ball rolling in the discussion. 一个简单的问题让讨论开了头。

collocations.translation: 走运，接连成功，势头正旺
collocations.example: The research team is on a roll this year. 这支研究团队今年势头正旺。

wordForms.noun: roll 卷；名册；小圆面包；roller 滚筒，滚轴；roll-out（新产品、新方案的）推出，推行
wordForms.verb: roll（rolled, rolled）滚动；卷起
wordForms.adjective: rolling 起伏的（rolling hills 连绵起伏的丘陵）；滚动推进的（a rolling programme 分批持续实施的方案）
wordForms.other: roll /rəʊl/ 与 role /rəʊl/（角色）读音完全相同，写作中极易混淆：play an important role in（×roll）。名词 roll-out 由短语动词 roll out 转化而来，中间加连字符；roll up 既可指"卷起（袖子、地图）"，也可指车辆"驶来、抵达"。

classPractice.question: The old man ______ (roll) up his sleeve and looked away as the nurse prepared the needle.
classPractice.note: 与并列谓语 looked away 保持一致，用一般过去时；roll up one's sleeve 意为"挽起袖子"。

classPractice.question: 政府计划下个月在全国推行这种新疫苗。The government plans to ______ ______ the new vaccine across the country next month.
classPractice.note: roll out 表"推出、推行（新产品或方案）"，plans to 后接动词原形；其名词形式为 roll-out。

translation: v. （使）滑行，滑动；悄悄地移动，塞入；（数量、水平）下滑，下跌 n. 滑动；（显微镜用的）载玻片；幻灯片；滑梯；下降，跌落
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to move smoothly over a surface, or to fall gradually to a lower level; a smooth movement, a small glass plate used under a microscope, or a picture shown on a screen

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕（显微镜用的）载玻片
uncommonMeanings.example: Put one drop of pond water on the slide. 在载玻片上滴一滴池塘水。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （演示用的）幻灯片
uncommonMeanings.example: Her last slide showed how vaccines train the body. 她最后一张幻灯片展示了疫苗如何训练身体。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕（数量、质量、状态）下滑，逐渐陷入
uncommonMeanings.example: Share prices slid for the third day running. 股价连续第三天下跌。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: let sth slide 放任不管，听任其变糟
uncommonMeanings.example: Don't let your health slide during exam week. 考试周别把身体搞垮。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （儿童玩的）滑梯
uncommonMeanings.example: The children queued for the slide in the park. 孩子们在公园里排队玩滑梯。

posExamples.sentence: The lab door slid open and a technician came out. 实验室的门滑开了，一名技术员走了出来。
She examined the bacteria on the glass slide carefully. 她仔细观察载玻片上的细菌。
Attendance has slid sharply since the outbreak began. 自疫情暴发以来出勤率大幅下滑。

collocations.example: Place the sample on a clean glass slide. 把样本放在干净的载玻片上。
The window slid shut with a soft click. 窗户轻轻一声滑上了。
Some people slide into anxiety after long isolation. 有些人在长期隔离后渐渐陷入焦虑。

collocations.translation: 把某物悄悄塞到……下面／里面
collocations.example: He slid the note under her door. 他把纸条从她门下塞了进去。
Water droplets slid down the cold glass. 水珠顺着冰凉的玻璃滑下。
Hygiene standards must not be allowed to slide. 卫生标准绝不能滑坡。
He went through the slides on droplet spread. 他过了一遍关于飞沫传播的幻灯片。
The ward has wide sliding doors. 这间病房有宽大的推拉门。

wordForms.noun: slide 滑动；载玻片；幻灯片；滑梯；slider 滑块，滑动条
wordForms.verb: slide（slid, slid）滑动；下滑
wordForms.adjective: sliding 滑动的（a sliding door 推拉门；a sliding scale 按比例浮动的收费标准）
wordForms.other: 不规则动词：slide-slid-slid，没有 ×slided。与 slip 辨析：slide 指平稳、连续地滑行或滑落；slip 多指脚下打滑、失足或口误（slip on the wet floor；a slip of the tongue 口误）。

classPractice.question: The heavy door ______ (slide) open and the nurse wheeled the trolley in.
classPractice.note: 与 wheeled 并列，用一般过去时；slide 是不规则动词，过去式为 slid，不能写成 ×slided。

classPractice.question: 别让自己的学业荒废下去。（let ... slide）______
classPractice.note: let sth slide 意为"放任某事变糟、不闻不问"；let 后接不带 to 的动词原形 slide。

translation: n. 目击者，见证人；证人；证据，证明 vt. 目击，亲眼看到；（某时期、某地）见证，经历；（在文件上）签字作证
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: a person who sees something happen or gives evidence in court; to see something happen, or (of a time or place) to be when or where something happens

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕（某一时期或地点）见证，是……发生的时候／地点（常用无灵主语）
uncommonMeanings.example: The past decade has witnessed rapid progress in vaccine research. 过去十年见证了疫苗研究的飞速进步。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （在文件上）签字作证，见证签署
uncommonMeanings.example: Two colleagues witnessed her signature on the form. 两位同事在表格上为她的签名作证。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕证据，证明（bear witness to sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her quick recovery bears witness to the doctors' skill. 她的迅速康复证明了医生们的医术。

posExamples.sentence: Three witnesses described how the boy had fainted in class. 三名目击者描述了那个男孩在课堂上晕倒的经过。
I witnessed the whole accident from the bus stop. 我在公交站目睹了整个事故。
This hospital witnessed the city's first mass vaccination. 这家医院见证了该市第一次大规模接种。

collocations.example: She was the key witness in the case. 她是此案的关键证人。
He witnessed a serious accident on his way home. 他回家路上目击了一起严重事故。

collocations.translation: （某时期）见证了……（写作亮点句式）
collocations.example: The last century witnessed the birth of modern vaccines. 上个世纪见证了现代疫苗的诞生。
The empty wards bear witness to the vaccine's success. 空荡的病房证明了疫苗的成功。
The lawyer called the doctor as a witness. 律师传唤那位医生作证。
She was a witness to the whole quarrel. 她目睹了整场争吵。
The agreement was signed in the presence of witnesses. 协议是在证人在场时签署的。

wordForms.noun: witness 目击者，证人；见证；eyewitness 目击者
wordForms.verb: witness（witnessed, witnessed）目击；见证；作证
wordForms.other: 构词：wit（知道，与 wise、wisdom 同源）+ -ness → "知情之人"。写作亮点句式：用时间或地点作无灵主语 + witness，如 The past ten years have witnessed... / This city has witnessed...。名词用 a witness to sth（介词用 to，不用 of）。

classPractice.question: The past twenty years ______ (witness) great progress in the fight against infectious diseases.
classPractice.note: the past twenty years 表示"过去二十年至今"，与现在完成时连用；主语为复数，故用 have witnessed。

classPractice.question: 他是这起事故唯一的目击者。He was the only ______ ______ the accident.
classPractice.note: 名词 witness 后接介词 to 表示"……的目击者、见证人"。

translation: v. 射击，开枪；射门，投篮；拍摄（电影、照片）；飞速移动，疾驰；发芽，抽枝 n. 嫩芽，新枝；拍摄（活动）；狩猎活动
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to fire a weapon or send a ball at a goal; to film or photograph something; to move very quickly; a new part growing on a plant

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕嫩芽，新枝
uncommonMeanings.example: Bamboo shoots are a common vegetable in southern China. 竹笋是中国南方常见的一种蔬菜。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕拍摄（电影、照片）
uncommonMeanings.example: The documentary was shot inside a hospital lab. 这部纪录片是在医院实验室里拍摄的。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕一次拍摄活动（a photo shoot 摄影拍摄）
uncommonMeanings.example: The photo shoot for the health campaign took a whole morning. 这次健康宣传的摄影拍摄花了一上午。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 飞奔，疾驰（强调突然而快速地移动）
uncommonMeanings.example: A cat shot across the road in front of us. 一只猫从我们面前飞蹿过马路。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: shoot a glance / look at sb 迅速瞥（瞪）某人一眼
uncommonMeanings.example: She shot an angry look at her brother. 她狠狠瞪了弟弟一眼。

posExamples.sentence: A rabbit shot across the path and vanished into the bushes. 一只兔子飞快地窜过小路，消失在灌木丛中。
Tiny green shoots appeared in the pot after three days. 三天后花盆里冒出了细小的绿芽。
They shot the health video in a real research lab. 他们在一间真正的研究实验室里拍了这段健康短片。

collocations.example: The number of cases shot up in December. 十二月病例数激增。
They shot a short film about hand-washing. 他们拍了一部关于洗手的短片。
Green shoots of recovery appeared in spring. 春天出现了复苏的迹象。
The soldiers were ordered not to shoot at anyone. 士兵们奉命不得向任何人开枪。
He shot a worried glance at the doctor. 他担忧地朝医生瞥了一眼。
The ambulance shot past the traffic lights. 救护车飞驰过红绿灯。

collocations.translation: 连珠炮似地向某人发问
collocations.example: Reporters shot questions at the young scientist. 记者们向那位年轻科学家连珠炮般发问。
He shot at goal from outside the box. 他在禁区外射门。

wordForms.noun: shoot 嫩芽，新枝；拍摄活动；shooting 射击；拍摄；shot 射击，一枪；投篮；（美）打一针，注射（a flu shot 流感疫苗针）
wordForms.verb: shoot（shot, shot）射击；拍摄；迅速移动；发芽
wordForms.adjective: —（分词作定语：a shooting star 流星；a shooting pain 突发的放射性剧痛）
wordForms.other: 不规则动词 shoot-shot-shot。名词 shot 在美式英语中还表示"打一针、注射"：a flu shot ≈ 英式 a flu jab ≈ an injection，讲疫苗时很常见。植物义 shoot（嫩芽）常与 root（根）、stem（茎）、leaf（叶）一起考。

classPractice.question: The number of infections ______ (shoot) up sharply after the new school term began.
classPractice.note: after 从句用 began，叙述过去，主句用过去式；shoot 是不规则动词，过去式为 shot（×shooted），shoot up 表数量"急剧上升"。

classPractice.question: 几天后，湿润的泥土里冒出了嫩绿的新芽。（shoot）______
classPractice.answer: A few days later, green shoots came up through the damp soil.
classPractice.note: 此处 shoot 用作可数名词，意为"嫩芽、新枝"，一般用复数 shoots，不可写成 ×shootings。

translation: n. 大自然，自然界；本性，天性；（事物的）性质，特点；种类，类型
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: all the plants, animals and physical things not made by people; also the basic qualities or character of a person or thing

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕（事物的）性质，特征（the nature of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Doctors are still studying the nature of the illness. 医生仍在研究这种疾病的性质。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 本性，天性（人或动物生来的性格）
uncommonMeanings.example: It is not in her nature to give up easily. 轻易放弃不是她的天性。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕种类，类型（of a ... nature；things of this nature）
uncommonMeanings.example: Problems of this nature need expert advice. 这类问题需要专家意见。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: let nature take its course 顺其自然，让事情自然发展（尤指让身体自行恢复）
uncommonMeanings.example: For a mild cold, doctors often let nature take its course. 对于轻感冒，医生常常让它自然痊愈。

posExamples.sentence: Masks feel strange at first, but soon become second nature. 戴口罩起初别扭，但很快就成了习惯。
By nature she is calm, so panic rarely affects her. 她天性沉着，很少受恐慌影响。
Millions of microorganisms in nature are still unknown to science. 自然界中数以百万计的微生物仍不为科学所知。

collocations.example: He is cheerful by nature. 他天性开朗。
Curiosity is part of human nature. 好奇是人性的一部分。
We must first understand the nature of the virus. 我们必须先了解这种病毒的性质。

collocations.translation: （对某人来说）习惯成自然的事
collocations.example: Hand-washing is second nature to nurses. 洗手对护士来说已成本能般的习惯。
These bacteria are widely found in nature. 这些细菌在自然界中广泛存在。

collocations.translation: 先天与后天（遗传与环境）
collocations.example: Both nature and nurture shape our mental health. 先天与后天共同塑造我们的心理健康。
The nurse gave a good-natured laugh. 那位护士和善地笑了笑。

wordForms.noun: nature 自然；本性；性质；naturalist 博物学家；naturalness 自然，天然
wordForms.verb: —（无对应动词；表"使入籍、使归化"用 naturalise/naturalize，由 natural 派生）
wordForms.adjective: natural 自然的；天生的；正常的 ↔ unnatural 不自然的
wordForms.adverb: naturally 自然地；天生地；（用于句首）当然，不出所料
wordForms.other: 表"大自然"时既不加冠词也不用复数：in nature、protect nature（×the nature）；表"性质"用 the nature of sth；表"本性"用 one's nature 或 by nature。构词：-natured 可构成复合形容词，good-natured 脾气好的，ill-natured 脾气坏的。

classPractice.question: Scientists are still trying to work out the exact nature ______ this new virus.
classPractice.note: the nature of sth 是固定搭配，表示"某物的性质"，中间的介词只能用 of。

classPractice.question: 他天性乐观，很少感到焦虑。（by nature）______
classPractice.answer: He is optimistic by nature and seldom feels anxious.
classPractice.note: by nature 意为"天生地、本性上"，作状语，nature 前不加冠词。

translation: vt. 模仿，效仿（他人的言行、做法）；（惟妙惟肖地）学……的腔调或动作；仿造，仿制；模拟（真实情况）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to copy the way someone speaks or behaves, or to make something that looks like or works like something real

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕仿造，仿制（使外观或质地像真品）
uncommonMeanings.example: This material is made to imitate real leather. 这种材料是仿真皮制成的。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔熟词僻义〕模拟、再现（真实过程，供研究或训练之用）
uncommonMeanings.example: A vaccine imitates an infection without making you ill. 疫苗模拟一次感染，却不会让你生病。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （惟妙惟肖地）学……的声音、动作（常为逗笑）
uncommonMeanings.example: She can imitate her teacher's voice perfectly. 她能把老师的声音学得惟妙惟肖。

posExamples.sentence: Vaccines work by imitating an infection the body can beat. 疫苗通过模拟一次身体能够战胜的感染而起作用。
Young children imitate the hygiene habits of the adults around them. 幼儿会模仿身边大人的卫生习惯。
He imitated the doctor's accent and made everyone laugh. 他学医生的口音，把大家都逗笑了。

collocations.example: The vaccine imitates an infection to train the immune system. 疫苗模拟感染，以训练免疫系统。

collocations.phrase: imitate the way sb does sth
collocations.translation: 模仿某人做某事的方式
collocations.example: Toddlers imitate the way their parents hold a cup. 幼儿会模仿父母端杯子的方式。
Children are quick to imitate what they see. 孩子们看到什么很快就学。
Her teaching method has been widely imitated. 她的教学方法被广泛效仿。
He wrote in imitation of his favourite author. 他模仿自己最喜欢的作家写作。
The bag is made of imitation leather. 这个包是人造革做的。
The copy was a poor imitation of the original. 这个复制品是原作的拙劣模仿。

wordForms.noun: imitation 模仿；仿制品；imitator 模仿者
wordForms.verb: imitate（imitated, imitated）模仿；仿制；模拟
wordForms.adjective: imitative 模仿的，仿造的；imitation 亦可作定语表"人造的、仿制的"（imitation leather 人造革）
wordForms.other: imitate 是及物动词，直接跟宾语，后面不加介词（imitate his voice，×imitate after/from his voice）。近义辨析：copy 照抄、复制；mimic 惟妙惟肖地模仿（常带戏谑）；simulate 用设备或模型模拟真实情况；imitate 语义最宽，可褒可贬。

classPractice.question: Children learn to speak by ______ (imitate) the sounds they hear around them.
classPractice.note: 介词 by 后须接动名词，故用 imitating，表示"通过模仿……的方式"。

classPractice.question: 孩子们常常模仿身边大人洗手的方式。（imitate）______
classPractice.answer: Children often imitate the way the adults around them wash their hands.
classPractice.note: imitate 是及物动词，后面直接跟宾语 the way...，不加介词；the way 后接定语从句，关系词（that/in which）可省略。

translation: vt. 吸引（注意力、兴趣）；使参与，使从事；雇用，聘请 vi. 参与，从事（in）；与…接触交流（with）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to attract and hold someone's attention or interest; to take part in an activity or make someone take part in it

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 雇用，聘请（engage sb as sth / to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: The hospital engaged two technicians for the vaccine trial. 医院为疫苗试验聘了两名技术员。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （齿轮、离合器）啮合，挂上
uncommonMeanings.example: Wait for the gears to engage before you accelerate. 等齿轮啮合后再加速。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 与…交战，同…作战（正式、军事语域）
uncommonMeanings.example: The troops engaged the enemy at dawn. 部队在黎明时与敌军交战。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （主英）（电话）占线的；（厕所、房间）有人使用的（美式多说 busy）
uncommonMeanings.example: I rang twice but the line was engaged. 我打了两次，电话都占线。

posExamples.sentence: A short video of gut bacteria engaged the whole class at once.
Many students engage in volunteer work during the vaccination campaign.
Scientists must engage with the public, not just with each other.

collocations.example: Doctors urge us to engage in moderate exercise for mental well-being. 医生建议我们进行适度锻炼以促进心理健康。

collocations.translation: 忙于，正从事于（engage in 的“状态”说法，强调正处于其中）
collocations.example: She is engaged in studying the human microbiome. 她正从事人体微生物组的研究。

collocations.translation: 使某人参与…；与某人展开（谈话等）
collocations.example: The school engaged students in a hand-washing campaign. 学校让学生参与了一场洗手宣传活动。

collocations.translation: 吸引（某人的）注意力／兴趣
collocations.example: The image under the microscope immediately engaged the children's attention. 显微镜下的图像立刻吸引了孩子们的注意。

collocations.translation: 与…接触交流；认真对待（问题）
collocations.example: Researchers should engage with the public to explain how vaccines work. 研究者应与公众交流，解释疫苗的原理。
My cousin is engaged to a nurse from the same ward. 我表姐和同一病区的一位护士订婚了。

collocations.phrase: engage sb as sth / to do sth
collocations.example: The lab engaged an expert to train the new staff. 实验室聘请了一位专家培训新员工。

collocations.translation: （学生／公众的）参与度，投入程度（名词形式，常见于说明文）
collocations.example: Short experiments raise student engagement in science classes. 小实验能提高学生在理科课堂上的参与度。

wordForms.noun: engagement 参与，投入；约定；订婚；交战
wordForms.verb: engage 吸引，使参与（engage-engaged-engaged）
wordForms.adjective: engaging 有吸引力的，讨人喜欢的；engaged 忙碌的，投入的；已订婚的；（电话）占线的
wordForms.adverb: engagingly 迷人地，招人喜欢地
wordForms.other: 词源 en-(使)+gage(抵押、保证)→使受约束→使参与。易错点：engaging 描述“事物／人有吸引力”（an engaging speaker），engaged 描述“人已投入、被占用”（fully engaged）；engage in 中 in 是介词，后跟名词或动名词，不能跟不定式。

classPractice.question: The documentary about gut bacteria was so ______ (engage) that nobody checked their phones.
classPractice.note: so...that 结构中需要形容词作表语，描述纪录片“有吸引力”用 -ing 形式 engaging；engaged 表示人“忙碌的、投入的”，不能形容纪录片本身。

classPractice.question: 许多学生积极参与校园防疫宣传。Many students actively ______ ______ the campus campaign against infection.
classPractice.note: “参与、投身于某活动”用 engage in sth；主语 students 为复数，一般现在时用动词原形 engage。

translation: vt. 刺激（身体、器官产生反应）；促进，激发（生长、兴趣、思考）；激励（某人做某事）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to make something develop or become more active, or to encourage someone's interest, thinking or action

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （用电流、药物等）刺激神经或肌肉（医学语域）
uncommonMeanings.example: Doctors use mild currents to stimulate the damaged nerve. 医生用微弱电流刺激受损的神经。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 刺激（经济、需求、消费）增长（经济语域）
uncommonMeanings.example: Lower prices stimulate demand for the new medicine. 降价刺激了对这种新药的需求。

posExamples.sentence: Vaccines stimulate the immune system to produce antibodies against the virus.
Bright, open classrooms stimulate curiosity and improve students' cognitive performance.

collocations.example: A vaccine stimulates the immune system without causing the disease. 疫苗刺激免疫系统，却不会引发疾病。
Gut bacteria stimulate the production of certain vitamins. 肠道细菌促进某些维生素的生成。

collocations.phrase: stimulate sb to do sth / into doing sth
collocations.example: His words stimulated us to look into the problem ourselves. 他的话激励我们自己去研究这个问题。
One drop of pond water stimulated my interest in microorganisms. 一滴池水激发了我对微生物的兴趣。
Sunlight stimulates the growth of algae in the pond. 阳光促进池塘中藻类的生长。
The article stimulated a heated debate about compulsory vaccination. 这篇文章引发了关于强制接种的激烈争论。

collocations.translation: 益智的，令人开动脑筋的
collocations.example: Puzzles are mentally stimulating for older people. 拼图对老年人有益智作用。
Tax cuts are meant to stimulate the economy. 减税意在刺激经济。

wordForms.noun: stimulation 刺激，激励（过程）；stimulus 刺激物，促进因素（复数 stimuli）；stimulant 兴奋剂，提神物
wordForms.verb: stimulate 刺激，激发（stimulate-stimulated-stimulated）
wordForms.adjective: stimulating 令人振奋的，有启发性的
wordForms.adverb: 无常用副词形式（stimulatingly 极少用）
wordForms.other: 源自拉丁语 stimulus（赶牲口的尖棒）→“戳一下使动起来”→刺激。三个名词别混：stimulus/stimuli 指“刺激因素”（可数），stimulation 指“刺激这件事”（不可数），stimulant 特指咖啡因等“兴奋剂”。句型 stimulate sb to do sth = stimulate sb into doing sth。

classPractice.question: Caffeine works as a ______ (stimulate) and can keep you awake for hours.
classPractice.note: a 后需可数名词单数；“兴奋剂、提神物”是 stimulant，不能填 stimulation（抽象的“刺激”）或 stimulus（泛指的“刺激因素”）。

classPractice.question: 疫苗刺激人体产生抗体。The vaccine ______ the body ______ ______ antibodies.
classPractice.note: stimulate sth to do sth“刺激…去做…”，宾语后接动词不定式，三空依次为 stimulates / to / produce；主语 The vaccine 是第三人称单数，一般现在时加 -s。

translation: vt. 观察，注视；注意到，察觉；遵守（法律、规则、习俗）；评论，说；庆祝，纪念（节日、仪式） vi. 观察，评述
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to watch someone or something carefully; also to obey a rule, to make a remark, or to celebrate an occasion

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 遵守（法规、习俗、礼节）
uncommonMeanings.example: All visitors must observe the hospital's hygiene rules. 所有到访者都必须遵守医院的卫生规定。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 评论说，指出（书面语域，相当于 remark）
uncommonMeanings.example: “The mould is growing fast,” the student observed. “霉长得真快，”那名学生说道。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 庆祝，纪念（节日、周年）
uncommonMeanings.example: Many countries observe World Health Day on 7 April. 许多国家在4月7日纪念世界卫生日。

posExamples.sentence: We observed the bacteria dividing under a powerful microscope.
Everyone working in the ward must observe strict hand-washing rules.
Good scientists observe first and explain later.

collocations.phrase: observe sb do sth / observe sb doing sth
collocations.translation: 观察／看到某人做某事（做了全过程／正在做）
collocations.example: We observed the white cells attack the bacteria. 我们观察到白细胞攻击了细菌。
Gut bacteria can only be observed under a microscope. 肠道细菌只有在显微镜下才能观察到。
Observe the sample closely before you draw any conclusion. 下结论前先仔细观察样本。
Everyone must observe the quarantine rules. 人人都必须遵守隔离规定。
Some families still observe old Spring Festival customs. 有些家庭仍遵循旧的春节习俗。

collocations.translation: 对某人进行观察／留院观察
collocations.example: The patient was kept under observation overnight. 病人被留院观察了一夜。
He made a sharp observation about the curve on the graph. 他对图上的曲线提出了敏锐的看法。
Scientists observed that droplets travelled further indoors. 科学家注意到飞沫在室内传播得更远。

wordForms.noun: observation 观察，观察力；言论。observer 观察者，观察员。observatory 天文台，观测站
wordForms.verb: observe 观察（observe-observed-observed）
wordForms.adjective: observant 观察力敏锐的；遵守（法规）的。observable 可观察到的，看得见的
wordForms.adverb: observantly 留心地，观察敏锐地
wordForms.other: ob-(朝向)+serve(注意、保持)→一直朝着看→观察。感官动词式用法：observe sb do sth 强调看到全过程，observe sb doing sth 强调看到正在进行；变被动时省略的 to 要还原：He was observed to leave the lab. 名词辨析：observation 指“观察”，observance 指“（对法规、节日的）遵守、遵行”。

classPractice.question: The nurse observed the child ______ (breathe) with difficulty and called the doctor at once.
classPractice.note: observe sb doing sth 表示“观察到某人正在做某事”，强调动作正在进行；若用 breathe（省 to 的不定式）则表示看到了完整过程，与“立刻叫医生”的语境不符。

classPractice.question: 所有到访者都必须遵守医院的卫生规定。All visitors must ______ the hospital's hygiene rules.
classPractice.note: 考 observe 的熟词僻义“遵守”（= obey / follow），常与 rules, the law, customs 搭配；情态动词 must 后用动词原形。

translation: n. 镜子；（车辆的）后视镜；（显微镜、望远镜的）反射镜；真实的写照 vt. 映出，反射（影像）；反映，与…情况一致
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: a piece of glass that reflects images; (as a verb) to reflect an image, or to be very similar to something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反映，与…如出一辙（变化、趋势同步）
uncommonMeanings.example: The sharp rise in cases mirrored the sudden return of large indoor gatherings. 病例的急剧上升与室内大型聚会的骤然恢复如出一辙。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 真实的写照，反映…的事物
uncommonMeanings.example: Literature is a mirror of the society that produces it. 文学是产生它的那个社会的写照。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （光学仪器上的）反射镜、聚光镜
uncommonMeanings.example: Tilt the mirror to send light through the slide. 转动反射镜，让光线穿过载玻片。

posExamples.sentence: He tilted the microscope's mirror to light up the tiny sample.
The curve on the chart mirrors the spread of droplets in closed rooms.
Check your rear-view mirror before you change lanes.

collocations.example: She looked in the mirror and saw how tired her eyes were. 她照了照镜子，看到自己眼睛有多疲惫。
Adjust the rear-view mirror before you drive off. 开车前先调好后视镜。

collocations.translation: 镜像；一模一样的人或物
collocations.example: The two halves of the snowflake were almost mirror images. 这片雪花的两半几乎互为镜像。

collocations.phrase: hold a mirror up to sth
collocations.example: The report holds a mirror up to our eating habits. 这份报告如实映照出我们的饮食习惯。
Her worry was mirrored in his tired face. 她的忧虑也写在他疲惫的脸上。
The rise in obesity mirrors changes in our gut bacteria. 肥胖率上升与肠道菌群的变化相一致。
A full-length mirror stood beside the changing room door. 更衣室门边立着一面穿衣镜。

collocations.translation: 模仿，与…的表情或行为一致
collocations.example: Babies naturally mirror their parents' expressions. 婴儿会自然地模仿父母的表情。

wordForms.noun: mirror 镜子，反射镜
wordForms.verb: mirror 映出；反映（mirror-mirrored-mirrored，现在分词 mirroring）
wordForms.adjective: mirrored 有镜面的；被映出的。mirror-like 镜面般的
wordForms.adverb: 无常用副词形式（mirror 主要用作名词和动词）
wordForms.other: 名词与动词同形同音，重音在第一音节 /ˈmɪrə/（美音 /ˈmɪrər/），拼写别漏掉双写的 -rr-。近义辨析：reflect 侧重“物理反射”和“体现”，mirror 作动词时更强调“高度相似、如出一辙”。mirror image 指左右相反的“镜像”，不是完全相同的复制品。

classPractice.question: In the still lake we could see the snow-capped mountains ______ (mirror) perfectly.
classPractice.note: see sth done 结构：mountains 与 mirror 是被动关系（山被映出），所以用过去分词 mirrored 作宾语补足语。

classPractice.question: 这两片雪花几乎互为镜像。The two snowflakes were almost ______ ______ of each other.
classPractice.note: 固定表达 a mirror image of sth“…的镜像”；主语是复数 two snowflakes，两片互为镜像，名词要用复数 mirror images。

translation: n. 位置，方位；姿势；职位，工作；处境，境况；立场，态度；（比赛中的）名次 vt. 安放，安置；把…摆在（某位置）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: the place where someone or something is, or the way they are placed; also a job, a situation, or an opinion on an issue

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 职位，工作岗位（较正式，招聘语域）
uncommonMeanings.example: She applied for a position in the vaccine laboratory. 她申请了疫苗实验室的一个职位。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 立场，观点，态度
uncommonMeanings.example: What is the school's position on compulsory masks? 学校对强制戴口罩持什么立场？

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 处境，境况（be in a position to do sth 有能力／有资格做某事）
uncommonMeanings.example: I'm not in a position to comment on the trial. 我没有资格对这项试验发表意见。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （小心地）安放，摆放，使处于某位置
uncommonMeanings.example: He positioned the mirror under the microscope stage. 他把反射镜安放在显微镜载物台下方。

posExamples.sentence: Move the slide until the sample is in exactly the right position.
Bentley positioned his camera carefully to photograph a single snowflake.
She has held a senior position at the research centre for years.

collocations.example: Make sure the cover glass is in position before you focus. 调焦前确保盖玻片已放到位。
The mirror was out of position, so the field looked dark. 反射镜没放正，所以视野一片昏暗。
He refused to change his position on compulsory vaccination. 他拒绝改变自己在强制接种问题上的立场。

collocations.phrase: be in a position to do sth
collocations.example: We are not yet in a position to explain the outbreak. 我们还没有能力解释这次疫情暴发的原因。
She applied for a position as a lab assistant. 她申请了实验室助理的职位。
The photographer took up a position beside the window. 摄影师在窗边站定。

collocations.translation: 小心地／精确地摆放某物
collocations.example: Position the sample exactly under the lens. 把样本正好放在镜头正下方。
Regular exercise puts you in a stronger position to fight infection. 经常锻炼使你处于更有利的抗感染状态。

wordForms.noun: position 位置，职位，立场；positioning 定位，安放（市场定位 market positioning）
wordForms.verb: position 安放，定位（position-positioned-positioned）；reposition 重新安置
wordForms.adjective: positional 位置的（a positional error 位置误差）
wordForms.adverb: 无常用副词形式（positionally 极少用）
wordForms.other: pos-/pon-（放置）词族：position 位置 / deposit 存放 / compose 组合 / oppose 反对。搭配区别：in position 意为“就位、放到位”（无冠词），in the position of 意为“处于…的职位／地位”。be in a position to do sth ≈ be able to do sth，后接不定式，否定式为 be in no position to do sth。

classPractice.question: I'm afraid I'm not in a position ______ (comment) on the trial results yet.
classPractice.note: be in a position to do sth“有资格／有能力做某事”是固定句型，position 后必须接动词不定式。

classPractice.question: 他小心地摆好相机，正对着一片雪花。He carefully ______ his camera to face a single snowflake.
classPractice.note: 考 position 作及物动词“（小心地）安放、摆放”；句子叙述过去动作，用过去式 positioned。

translation: vt. 使增强，加剧，加大（力度）；使（颜色、感觉等）更浓烈 vi. 变强烈，加剧，增强
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to become greater, stronger or more extreme, or to make something do this

posExamples.sentence: Crowded indoor spaces intensify the spread of respiratory droplets.
The storm intensified overnight and closed the mountain road.
Schools have intensified efforts to protect students' psychological well-being.

collocations.example: The government intensified efforts to vaccinate older people. 政府加大了为老年人接种疫苗的力度。
Careless sharing of rumours intensified the spread of panic online. 随意转发谣言加剧了恐慌在网上的扩散。
Exam season intensifies pressure on senior students. 考试季加剧了高年级学生的压力。
Labs around the world intensified research into the new vaccine. 世界各地的实验室加强了对这种新疫苗的研究。
Her symptoms intensified rapidly over two days. 她的症状在两天内迅速加重。
A dark background intensifies the colour of the crystal. 深色背景使晶体的颜色显得更鲜明。
As the wind intensified, the snow began to swirl. 风越刮越猛，雪开始打旋。

wordForms.noun: intensity 强度，烈度；intensification 加强，加剧
wordForms.verb: intensify （使）加剧（intensify-intensified-intensified，第三人称单数 intensifies）
wordForms.adjective: intense 强烈的，剧烈的；热切的。intensive 密集的，加强的（intensive care 重症监护）
wordForms.adverb: intensely 强烈地，极度地。intensively 密集地，集中地
wordForms.other: -ify 是构成动词的后缀：simplify 简化 / purify 净化 / classify 分类 / intensify 加强。拼写：辅音字母+y 结尾，变位时 y→i，故 intensifies / intensified / intensifying。形容词辨析：intense 说“程度深”（intense pain 剧痛），intensive 说“方式密集”（intensive training 强化训练，ICU = intensive care unit）。

classPractice.question: Poor ventilation ______ (intensify) the spread of droplets in a crowded classroom.
classPractice.note: 陈述普遍事实用一般现在时，主语 Poor ventilation 不可数、视为第三人称单数；辅音字母+y 结尾变第三人称单数要 y→ies，写作 intensifies。

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（intense / intensive / intensify）：Heat and crowding ______ the risk of infection, and patients in ______ care units often suffer ______ pain.
classPractice.note: 第一空缺谓语动词，主语 Heat and crowding 为复数，用原形 intensify“加剧”；intensive care unit 是固定说法“重症监护室”；修饰 pain 表示“剧烈的”用 intense，不能用 intensive。

translation: n.（大图角落里的）小图，插图；（书刊的）插页；嵌入物 vt. 嵌入，插入（小图、文字）；镶嵌（宝石、材料） adj. 嵌入式的，凹进去的
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: a small picture or map placed inside a larger one; (as a verb) to fix or place something inside something else

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （杂志、报纸中的）插页，夹页
uncommonMeanings.example: The magazine came with a four-page inset on health. 这本杂志附了一份四页的健康专题插页。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 镶嵌（宝石、贝壳等材料）
uncommonMeanings.example: The wooden lid was inset with tiny pearls. 木盖上镶着细小的珍珠。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 嵌入式的，凹入墙面／表面的
uncommonMeanings.example: Inset lights above each bench keep the lab bright. 每张实验台上方的嵌入式灯让实验室很亮堂。

posExamples.sentence: The inset shows the same snowflake at a much higher magnification.
The editor inset a small photo of the virus in the corner.
An inset panel on the page explains how vaccines work.

collocations.example: An inset map shows where the outbreak began. 角落的小地图标出了疫情始发的地点。
The crystal has six identical arms (see inset). 该晶体有六条完全相同的枝杈（见小图）。
In the inset you can clearly see the tiny hooks. 在小图中可以清楚看到那些细小的钩子。
The silver box was inset with mother-of-pearl. 那只银盒镶着珍珠母。
The designer inset a tiny lens into the frame. 设计师把一枚小镜头嵌进了镜框。
An inset box lists the symptoms to watch for. 一个插入方框列出了需要注意的症状。

collocations.translation: 嵌入式搁架／凹入式窗户（形容词用法）
collocations.example: An inset shelf holds the specimen jars. 一个嵌入式搁架上放着标本瓶。

wordForms.noun: inset 插图，小图，插页，嵌入物
wordForms.verb: inset 嵌入，镶嵌（inset-inset-inset，少数词典亦收 insetted；现在分词 insetting）
wordForms.adjective: inset 嵌入的，凹入的（an inset window 嵌入式窗户）
wordForms.other: 重音辨词性：名词 /ˈɪnset/ 重音在前，动词 /ˌɪnˈset/ 重音在后（同类：ˈrecord 名词 / reˈcord 动词）。动词三态与原形同形 inset-inset-inset，现在分词双写 t 作 insetting。与 insert 区分：insert 是“插入”这个动作（insert a needle），inset 更多指“嵌在大图／大件里的那个小图、小件”。

classPractice.question: 右下角的小图显示了牛蒡果实上的钩子。The ______ in the bottom right corner shows the hooks on the burdock fruit.
classPractice.note: inset 作名词，指大图角落里嵌入的“小图、插图”；此处 The 后接单数名词，且谓语 shows 为单数，故用 inset。

classPractice.question: The silver lid was ______ (inset) with tiny blue stones.
classPractice.note: be inset with sth“镶嵌着…”，was 后为被动语态，需要过去分词；inset 属不规则动词，三态同形（inset-inset-inset），故仍填 inset，不加 -ed。

translation: n. 钩，挂钩；鱼钩；（植物、动物身上的）钩状物；（拳击）钩拳；（歌曲、文章中）吸引人的部分，“钩子” vt. 钩住，挂上；用钩固定；使入迷 vi. 弯曲成钩状；被钩住
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: a curved piece of metal or plastic used for hanging or catching things; (as a verb) to fasten or catch something with a hook

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （歌曲、广告、文章开头）最抓人的部分，“钩子”（非正式）
uncommonMeanings.example: The song's hook stays in your head all day. 这首歌最抓耳的那段能在脑子里绕一整天。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使着迷，使上瘾
uncommonMeanings.example: Many teenagers are hooked on short videos. 许多青少年沉迷于短视频。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （拳击）钩拳
uncommonMeanings.example: He knocked his opponent down with a left hook. 他一记左钩拳把对手击倒。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把（仪器、设备）连接上
uncommonMeanings.example: The monitor was hooked up to the patient. 监护仪与病人连接好了。

posExamples.sentence: Tiny hooks on burdock seeds gave the inventor the idea for Velcro.
She hooked her lab coat over the back of the chair.
The song's catchy hook makes the health message easy to remember.

collocations.example: Hang your lab coat on the hook by the door. 把白大褂挂在门边的挂钩上。

collocations.translation: 钩毛式扣件，魔术贴（尼龙搭扣）
collocations.example: Velcro is a hook-and-loop fastener copied from burdock. 尼龙搭扣是仿照牛蒡发明的钩毛式扣件。
He hooked the lamp over the microscope stand. 他把灯钩在显微镜的支架上。
He is hooked on his phone and sleeps badly. 他手机上瘾，睡眠很差。
The nurse hooked the patient up to a heart monitor. 护士把病人接上了心电监护仪。

collocations.translation: 放某人一马，让某人脱身（非正式）
collocations.example: The teacher let him off the hook this time. 老师这次放了他一马。

collocations.translation: 千方百计，想尽一切办法（习语）
collocations.example: She was determined to finish the project by hook or by crook. 她下决心不惜任何办法完成这个项目。
He won the round with a sharp left hook. 他以一记凌厉的左钩拳赢下了这一回合。

wordForms.noun: hook 钩子，挂钩
wordForms.verb: hook 钩住，挂上（hook-hooked-hooked）；unhook 解开，从钩上取下
wordForms.adjective: hooked 钩状的；着迷的，上瘾的
wordForms.other: 名词与动词同形。派生词 hooked 有两个截然不同的义项：一是“钩状的”（a hooked beak 钩状的喙、hooked seeds 带钩的种子），二是“上瘾的、着迷的”（be hooked on sth）。读音提醒：/hʊk/ 是短音，与 book、look、cook 同韵，不要读成长音 /huːk/。

classPractice.question: Once she started listening to the science podcast, she was completely ______ (hook) on it.
classPractice.note: be hooked on sth“迷上、对…上瘾”，此处需要形容词化的过去分词 hooked 作表语；不能填 hooking（那表示“正在钩住”的主动含义）。

classPractice.question: 牛蒡果实上的小钩子启发了魔术贴的发明。The tiny ______ on the burdock fruit inspired the invention of Velcro.
classPractice.note: hook 作可数名词指“钩状物”；牛蒡果实上布满许多小钩，空前只有 The 而无 a/an，故用复数 hooks。

translation: n. 细绳，线，带子（材料义不可数）；一串，一连串，一系列；（乐器的）弦，[the strings]（乐队的）弦乐组  v. 把（绳、线、灯等）系上、挂起、拉起，架设；把…串成一串；给（乐器、球拍）装弦、穿线
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: (n.) thin cord or twine used for tying or hanging things (uncountable in this sense); a number of similar things or events coming one after another; a tightly stretched wire or cord on a musical instrument, and [the strings] the string section of an orchestra. (v.) to hang or stretch something between two points; to thread beads or similar objects onto a line; to fit an instrument or a racket with strings.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 〔计算机〕字符串（由字母、数字等字符排成的一串）
uncommonMeanings.example: Your password must be a string of at least eight characters. 你的密码必须是一串至少八个字符的字符串。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （球队按水平分的）阵容层级，梯队；常见于 first-string 主力的、second-string 替补的
uncommonMeanings.example: He spent a whole season on the second string before he became a starter. 他当了整整一个赛季的替补，之后才成为首发。

uncommonMeanings.partOfSpeech: adj.（由 strung 构成的固定搭配）
uncommonMeanings.meaning: highly strung〈英〉/ high-strung〈美〉神经紧绷的，易紧张激动的
uncommonMeanings.example: She is highly strung and sleeps badly before every exam. 她神经很紧绷，每次考试前都睡不好。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: string sth out 把…排成长长的一列；把…拖长（时间、谈判等）
uncommonMeanings.example: By the tenth kilometre the runners were strung out along the river road. 到第十公里时，跑者们已沿滨河路拉成了长长的一列。

posExamples.sentence: There isn't enough string left to tie up all these boxes.
A string of poor decisions cost the team the championship.
One of the strings on his guitar snapped halfway through the song.

posExamples.partOfSpeech: v. [T]（把…拉起，架设；过去式 strung）
posExamples.sentence: Volunteers strung colourful flags across the school gate.

collocations.phrase: a piece / a ball / a length of string
collocations.translation: 一根／一团／一段细绳（string 表"绳子"这一材料时不可数，须借助单位词）
collocations.example: Have you got a ball of string? The kite needs a longer line. 你有一团细绳吗？风筝需要更长的线。

collocations.phrase: a string of + 复数名词
collocations.translation: 一连串的，一系列的（研究、事故、停电、失败等）
collocations.example: A string of power cuts left the village in darkness last winter. 去年冬天一连串停电让村子陷入黑暗。
The old letters were tied up with string and kept in a shoebox. 那些旧信用绳子捆着，收在一个鞋盒里。

collocations.translation: 暗中操纵，动用关系（非正式，常含贬义；源自提线木偶）
collocations.example: His uncle pulled a few strings to get him an interview. 他叔叔动用关系给他弄到一次面试机会。

collocations.translation: 不附带任何条件地（strings 在此固定用复数，意为"附加条件"）
collocations.example: The scholarship is a gift with no strings attached. 这笔奖学金是一份不附带任何条件的馈赠。

collocations.translation: 把（词句、想法）连缀成篇，连贯地说出（多用于否定句）
collocations.example: He was so nervous that he could hardly string a sentence together. 他紧张得几乎连一句完整的话都说不出来。

collocations.translation: （用假承诺）吊着某人，欺骗某人（非正式）
collocations.example: Stop stringing her along—tell her the truth. 别再吊着她了，把实情告诉她。
A string quartet played Mozart at the opening ceremony. 开幕式上一个弦乐四重奏组演奏了莫扎特的作品。

wordForms.noun: string 细绳；一串；琴弦（复数 strings；the strings 指乐队的弦乐组）
wordForms.verb: string 系上，挂起，串起（不规则变化：string – strung – strung，现在分词 stringing）
wordForms.adjective: stringy 多筋的，纤维多的（stringy meat 发柴的肉）；stringed 有弦的，一般只作定语，如 stringed instruments 弦乐器
wordForms.adverb: —（本词没有常用副词形式，不可写作 *stringly）
wordForms.other: 四点真提示：①动词过去式／过去分词是 strung（string–strung–strung），不能写成 *stringed；stringed 只用作形容词，且多作定语：stringed instruments 弦乐器。②可数性看词义：指"绳子"这种材料时不可数，要说 a piece / a ball / a length of string；指"一串、琴弦、字符串"时可数，如 two strings。③a string of + 复数名词 作主语时，中心词是单数的 string，谓语通常用单数：A string of studies has shown…（口语中受后面复数名词影响偶见复数谓语，考试按单数写）。④习语 How long is a piece of string? 意为"这问题根本没法回答"。

classPractice.question: To cheer up the children in the ward, the nurses ____ (string) paper lanterns across the corridor.
classPractice.note: string 是不规则动词，string–strung–strung；句子叙述过去发生的动作，故填过去式 strung。不能写成 *stringed——现代英语中 stringed 只作形容词（stringed instruments 弦乐器）。

classPractice.question:
一连串新研究已把肠道细菌与我们的心理健康联系了起来。
____ ____ ____ new studies has linked gut bacteria to our mental well-being.
classPractice.note: "a string of + 复数名词"意为"一连串的、一系列的"；该短语作主语时中心词是单数的 string，故与之呼应的谓语用 has linked，而不是 have linked。三空恰好填 A / string / of。

classPractice.question: The company offered the school ten computers with no ____ (string) attached.
classPractice.note: 考固定习语 with no strings attached"不附带任何条件"：此处 string 取"附加条件"义，必须用复数 strings；attached 为过去分词作后置定语修饰 strings。
